title: Ādittam
text: Ādittasmim agārasmiṃ || yaṃ nīharati bhājanaṃ || taṃ tassa hoti atthāya || no ca yaṃ tattha ḍayhatīti || || Evam ādīpito loko || jarāya maraṇena ca || nīhareth-eva dānena || dinnaṃ hoti sunīhataṃ || || [page 032] 32 DEVATĀ-SAṂYUTTA I. [I. 5. 1. dinnaṃ sukhaphalaṃ hoti || nādinnam hoti taṃ tathā || corā haranti rājāno || aggī ḍayhati nassati || || Atha antena jahāti || sarīraṃ sapariggahaṃ || etad aññāya medhāvi || bhuñjetha ca dadetha ca || datvā bhutvā ca yathānubhāvaṃ || anindito saggam upeti ṭhānan ti || ||
